Subject: Request: Startup credits & discount path for our cohort

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking a look at BlueHorizon last week. We're finalizing the terms for the fall accelerator cohort and I wanted to confirm a few things on the Redwood side before we lock in the sponsor package. Specifically:

- Can the standard "startup credit" be layered on top of a cohort discount, or are they mutually exclusive?
- For early-stage startups in our program (pre-seed / < $1M ARR), is there flexibility to extend credits beyond the 90-day window if they hit milestones?
- Do you offer a one-time pilot top-up for demos (we expect a spike during demo week)?

Attaching a short usage projection so you can see likely token volume during onboarding and demo week.

Appreciate any flexibility here — we try to keep tool costs low for founders during the first 6 months.

Best,
Emma Ortiz
Program Director
BlueHorizon Labs

Attachment: BlueHorizon_Q4_usage_projection.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Kyle Tran <kyle@bluehorizon.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Startup credits & discount path for our cohort

Hi Emma — great to hear from you and thanks for the projection, that helps a lot. Quick answers up front and then a proposed path so we can move to signature: 

1) Layering: We can stack a founder "startup credit" (one-off) with a cohort discount, but only if the cohort discount is applied as a transient promo on top of the paid plan rather than a contract-level rebate. In practice we do this for 6-8 accelerator partners.

2) Extension by milestone: We can make a conditional extension (e.g., extend remaining credits up to 90 more days) if the startup meets a defined milestone (e.g., active integrations + demo delivered). That requires sign-off from sales leadership for program-wide exceptions.

3) Demo week top-up: We can grant a one-time pilot top-up (typically 25-30% of the allotted credits) scoped to the week of the demo. We usually do this as a billed credit that triggers only if usage in that window exceeds X tokens to avoid open-ended spend.

Proposed next steps:
- I can draft a Sponsor Addendum that: (a) applies a 20% cohort promo for 3 months, (b) layers a $3k startup credit per qualifying company, and (c) includes a conditional 30% demo-week top-up contingent on delivering a demo and a basic usage report.
- I'll loop in Laura for approval on the milestone extension clause and Marissa for partner-facing packaging language.

If that sounds good, I'll prepare a one-page addendum and a short milestone checklist for you.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
